name: Mind Control Lover
original_name: マインドコントロール・ラバー
source:
The main character is a teacher. He secretly has a feeling for a girl in his school.
Her name is Mahiru. She is a very brilliant student and he sometimes helps her from troubles.
One day, he hears a rumor that she now has a boyfriend.
That makes him very jealous and then an incident occurs...
